7/ Again, I’m glad the war might end. Thousands of innocent people have been killed. Our economy has been ruined. 

But that doesn’t mean we should be silent on how incompetent Trump is and how insane this war was from the start.

6/ Of course, none of those things could be accomplished by an air campaign - which is why so many of us opposed this war. 

And now the new regime is emboldened. They took our best shot and beat us. Iran emerges more powerful.

5/ And just remember, Trump hasn’t accomplished ANY of his constantly shifting goals. Iran still has its ballistic missile and drone program. They still have a navy that can close the Strait. A hardline regime is still in charge.

4/ But a promise to ship out enriched uranium (the reported concession) was also in Obama’s deal (as well as a lot of other things Trump will never get). 

And now that we are dropping sanctions, we have less leverage to get them to give more in future negotiations.
3/ There are reports there may be a tiny nuclear concession from Iran in the deal and if so, great. But I doubt it - they are most likely postponing all the nuclear issues.

2/ The deal is basically this: we give Iran billions to get back to where we were before the war. And reports suggest the deal might codify Iran’s right to control the Strait. 

What a disaster this whole thing was.

If this deal with Iran is real, I will welcome it because every day this insane war goes on, America gets weaker. The priority is to end the war - now.

But make no mistake: these are Iran’s terms. Our nation emerges humiliated.

1/ A 🧵 on what we know about the deal right now.

We live in a country now where the president uses his power to censor media figures who criticize him and then brags about it.
